description: A conductor needs a clear record of who is covering which part, where substitutions exist, and which parts are still underprepared in an upcoming program. All ensemble names and musicians are fictional.

user_profile.persona: 46-year-old conductor managing a mixed-experience chamber ensemble
user_profile.context: The repertoire is set, but several coverage adjustments have accumulated over recent rehearsals
user_profile.communication_style: Clarity-focused and musical, wants people-to-part assignments made explicit without unnecessary prose

fact_sheet.fact: The name of the ensemble is 'The Aethelred Chamber Players'.
Clara Vance is the Principal for the Violin I section.
Anya Sharma is the Principal for the Violin II section.
Marcus Thorne is the Principal for the Cello section.
Elara Song is the contracted Principal Viola player.
Leo Finch is substituting for Elara Song on Viola for the concert on October 28th, 2023.
The substitution for Elara Song was approved on October 15th, 2023, due to a family emergency.
Leo Finch's contact phone number is 555-0182.
The upcoming program is titled 'Autumnal Equinox Concert'.
The program includes W.A. Mozart's Divertimento in D, K. 136.
The program includes Benjamin Britten's 'Simple Symphony', Op. 4.
The program includes Arvo Pärt's 'Fratres' (1977 version for strings and percussion).
The Arvo Pärt piece requires a solo violin part, assigned to Clara Vance.
Kenji Tanaka (Bassoon) is only required for the Britten piece.
Maria Flores is assigned to Horn I and Samuel Jones is assigned to Horn II for the Britten.
The Cello section has marked the fugue in Britten's 'Simple Symphony', bars 92-114, as 'underprepared' as of the October 21st rehearsal.
The Horn II part in the Britten 'Simple Symphony', movement 3 'Sentimental Sarabande', has a persistent intonation issue at bar 22.
The Violin II section has requested a sectional to review bowing for the opening of Mozart's K. 136.
The final tutti section of 'Fratres', from Rehearsal Mark P to the end, is not yet rhythmically secure.
The next full ensemble rehearsal is scheduled for Wednesday, October 25th, 2023, from 7:30 PM to 10:00 PM.
The rehearsal on October 25th will take place at The Eldridge Community Arts Center, Room 201.
A dedicated strings-only sectional is scheduled for Tuesday, October 24th, at 7:00 PM in Room 3B to address bowing and rhythm.
The concert is on Saturday, October 28th, 2023, at 8:00 PM at Lyceum Hall.
The call time for all musicians for the October 28th concert is 6:45 PM backstage.
The dress code for the October 28th performance is 'concert black'.
David Chen is the assigned musician for the Double Bass part.

user_needs.description: Who is substituting for the Principal Viola for the October 28th concert?
What is the contact phone number for the viola substitute, Leo Finch?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: After identifying a substitute, the conductor will likely need their contact information for coordination.

user_needs.description: Who are the principals for the Violin I, Violin II, and Cello sections?
Which section has marked the fugue in Britten's 'Simple Symphony' as underprepared, and which specific bars are affected?
Who is the principal player leading the underprepared cello section in Britten's fugue?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After reviewing the principal roster, a direct follow-up is which principal leads the cello section that was flagged as underprepared in Britten's fugue.

user_needs.description: At which rehearsal was the Britten fugue passage marked as underprepared?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After confirming which section and bars in Britten's fugue are underprepared, a direct follow-up is when that concern was recorded so the conductor can judge how recent the issue is.

user_needs.description: Which section of Arvo Pärt's 'Fratres' is not yet rhythmically secure?
When and where is the dedicated strings-only sectional scheduled?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After identifying the underprepared cello section and its lead player, a direct follow-up is when the strings-only sectional is scheduled to address those preparation issues.

user_needs.description: What are the time and location for the next full ensemble rehearsal?
Which section requested a sectional to review bowing for the opening of Mozart's K. 136?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After confirming that a strings-only sectional has been scheduled, a direct follow-up is which section specifically requested extra bowing work.
